# Upgrading: renamed and removed names

The names a release renamed, reshaped or removed, under the Upgrade page section that explains
each, newest first: every composable, component, factory, type and constant the page lists as
gone, and the calls and options whose shape changed. When code written for an earlier version
fails on a name, find it in the **Was** column and write what **Now** says; the section's link
has the reasons and every step. The core skill's `references/renames.json`, in
`nuxt-backend`, holds the same entries as data.

- **renamed**: the same thing under a new name.
- **reshaped**: the same name, called or read differently.
- **removed**: gone. **Now** names what to use instead; a — means nothing replaces it.

`npx nuxt-backend upgrade` rewrites none of this: make each edit in the app's code yourself.
After it, run `npx nuxt-backend doctor`, and `npx nuxt-backend init --agents` to refresh the app's
agent files and skills.

## [A composable falls back when the app lacks its backend file](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#a-composable-falls-back-when-the-app-lacks-its-backend-file)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | `_generated/api.d.ts` | reshaped | the packaged plugin provides only the modules `_generated/api.d.ts` lists, so a namespace it doesn't list reads as absent and its composable falls back; an app that commits `_generated/` commits it again after adding a backend file |

## [`doctor --fix` asks before it syncs email, and a deploy runs the package's migrations](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#doctor---fix-asks-before-it-syncs-email-and-a-deploy-runs-the-packages-migrations)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `doctor --fix` | `--yes` | reshaped | the email sync is planned as a dry run and applied on a yes at a terminal or with `--yes`; without either it lists the plan and writes nothing, and a sync that fails fails `doctor --fix` |
| `npx nuxt-backend upgrade --prod --yes` | `npx nuxt-backend deploy` | reshaped | `deploy` and `deploy --build` run the package's data migrations and the workpool's backfill after a production push; the `upgrade --prod --yes` step after them finds nothing left, and stays only after a deploy that runs `convex deploy` itself |

## [A replaced page follows its shape, and `nuxt dev` serves its modules from a path of their own](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#a-replaced-page-follows-its-shape-and-nuxt-dev-serves-its-modules-from-a-path-of-their-own)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/_nuxt/` | `/_dev/` | reshaped | on `nuxt dev`, an app that sets no `app.buildAssetsDir` gets its modules from `/_dev/`, and every module is served `Cache-Control: no-cache` unless the app sets its own in `vite.server.headers`; match `/_dev/` in a dev proxy rule or test matcher |
| `r/[...slug].vue` | `app/pages/r/[code].vue` | reshaped | only a page of the packaged page's shape replaces it; a catch-all or optional page leaves the packaged page beside it |

## [Plan switches ask first, and prices keep their currency's own digits](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#plan-switches-ask-first-and-prices-keep-their-currencys-own-digits)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<PricingTable>` | `proration: 'invoice'` | reshaped | a subscriber's switch asks first and bills the difference at once; a gifted plan's holder checks the new plan out; `usePricing().bind.planAction` switches the same way without asking |
| `$99.00` | `$99` | reshaped | amounts follow the currency's smallest unit (whole JPY, KRW and the other zero-decimal currencies, thousandths for BHD, JOD, KWD, OMR and TND), a whole amount with no decimals, in the pages and the renewal email alike; 0.3 divided every amount by 100 |

## [An app's own error sentence keeps winning, and the browser's install banner stays](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#an-apps-own-error-sentence-keeps-winning-and-the-browsers-install-banner-stays)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors.unavailable` | `errors.unavailable_<service>` | reshaped | a refusal from a service that is down reads `errors.unavailable_<service>` when no sentence for the reason fits; the app's own labels are searched first, so its `errors.unavailable` keeps winning |
| `installable` | `backend.installable.browserBanner: false` | reshaped | `useInstallPrompt()` keeps the browser's install event and leaves its own banner showing; `browserBanner: false` stops the banner |

## [Member tickets credit their member as a referral, and tokens leave the address bar](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#member-tickets-credit-their-member-as-a-referral-and-tokens-leave-the-address-bar)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `access.memberTickets` | `access.memberTickets({ referrals })` | reshaped | pass the app's `setupReferrals` instance for each friend a ticket admits to be claimed as its member's referral, as their account is made |
| `/waitlist` | `the status email's link` | reshaped | the page keeps a status token in the tab, never in the address, so a bookmark no longer holds a place |

## [A job waits for billing to catch up, and owes a charge the provider refuses for now](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#a-job-waits-for-billing-to-catch-up-and-owes-a-charge-the-provider-refuses-for-now)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `insufficient_credits` | `not_ready` | reshaped | a job whose first step finds no credit meter or no billing customer yet waits about five minutes, its hold taken, then fails `not_ready` (reason `not_synced` or `no_customer`); only a balance short of the credits fails `insufficient_credits` |
| `job.charge` | `onOwedCharge` | reshaped | a refusal that may pass (no answer, `408`, `429`, `5xx`, no customer yet) leaves the charge owed: the job ends `done` with `owed`, its credits held, and the queue tries it in the background; any other `4xx` gives it up at once, the job still `done` and its hold back |
| `NoImageGeneratedError` | `retryable(message)` | reshaped | an empty image answer is tried once more, then fails `provider_refused`; with a finish reason for safety it fails `content_blocked` at once; throw `retryable(message)` to keep four attempts |

## [`billing sync` prices every product in the organization's currency, and attaches the benefits a product lacks](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#billing-sync-prices-every-product-in-the-organizations-currency-and-attaches-the-benefits-a-product-lacks)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog priced in its pinned `currency` alone` | `prices: { usd: { month: 1200 }, eur: { month: 1100 } }` | reshaped | every paid plan and pack carries a price in the organization's default currency, or `billing sync` refuses the catalog before it creates anything; `doctor` names them (`billing-currency`) |
| `benefit attached to an existing product by hand` | `billing sync` | reshaped | the sync attaches a credit grant or a feature a plan's product lacks, and the provider grants it to its current subscribers; a second credit grant on one meter, and a pack's missing credits, are reported as drift instead |

## [The Better Auth client loads on first use, and a failed server call names its function](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#the-better-auth-client-loads-on-first-use-and-a-failed-server-call-names-its-function)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nuxt-convex-module` | `nuxt-convex-module@^0.14.0` | reshaped | the dependency's range; an app that lists the base module itself moves with it |
| `useBetterAuth().client.$store` | `(await loadAuthClient()).$store` | reshaped | a forwarding client until the auth client loads: calls ($fetch included) and use* hooks work as before; read $store.atoms or a plugin atom on the loaded client |
| `fetchQuery` | `fetchQuery` | reshaped | a failure's message starts with [CONVEX Q(module:fn)], as fetchMutation's and fetchAction's do; read getBackendError(error) rather than compare the message |

## [The upload field retries a failure, and prepares a file before it uploads](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#the-upload-field-retries-a-failure-and-prepares-a-file-before-it-uploads)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `useUploadField` | `useUploadField({ claim, prepare })` | reshaped | returns retry and bind.retry; a failure ends in error with Try again, a refusal in refused, and the error slot adds refused and retry |

## [Emails and notifications read the labels app config sets](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#emails-and-notifications-read-the-labels-app-config-sets)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `setupEmail({ paths, brand })` | `setupEmail({ paths, brand, labels })` | reshaped | import `labels` from `./labels.generated`, which `upgrade` writes; drop the copy `messages` repeated from app config |

## [Moderation verdicts name shared categories](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#moderation-verdicts-name-shared-categories)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai.moderate` | `ai.moderate` | reshaped | `categories` names shared categories (`sexual`, `hate`); the classifier's codes (`S12`) moved to `codes`, beside `scores` and `providers`; `block` and `escalate` take either |

## [A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#a-production-checkout-waits-for-billing-to-launch-and-welcome-credits-come-from-the-catalog)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| ``unavailable` (reason `not_configured`) from a production checkout` | ``unavailable` (reason `not_launched`)` | reshaped | only a sale on a production deployment with no token or no production catalog; every other refusal keeps `not_configured` |
| ``not_ready` (reason `no_catalog`) from a production checkout` | ``unavailable` (reason `not_launched`)` | reshaped | a production deployment with a token whose catalog `billing sync --env production` never wrote; a sandbox one keeps `no_catalog` |
| `billing.refundCredits in onUserCreated` | `credits: { meter, units, once: true }` | reshaped | welcome credits on the free plan, granted once per person on the first start, as soon as the reverse trial begins; drop the hand-rolled grant |

## [A job step stops its model calls at its timeout](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#a-job-step-stops-its-model-calls-at-its-timeout)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobs.step` | `jobs.step` | reshaped | a step aborts its model calls at `timeout`, by default 3 minutes or 80% of `stallAfter`; set `timeout` for a longer step, below `stallAfter` |

## [Members bring friends with a ticket of their own, and the waitlist records the campaign](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#members-bring-friends-with-a-ticket-of-their-own-and-the-waitlist-records-the-campaign)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `access.invites.create with a label per member` | `access.memberTickets({ uses, lifetime })` | reshaped | re-export its `api` (`getMemberTicket`, `issueMemberTicket`) and read it with `useMemberTicket()`; drop the table of links the app kept |
| `useWaitlist({ source })` | `useWaitlist({ source, campaign })` | reshaped | the address's `utm_source` and `utm_campaign` follow the source; `campaign: false` records the source alone |

## [A job joins on a balance never read](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#a-job-joins-on-a-balance-never-read)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobs.enqueue` | `jobs.enqueue` | reshaped | a balance never read no longer refuses `not_synced`: the job joins, and its first step reads the balance or fails `insufficient_credits`; a balance read with no credit meter is still refused `not_ready` |

## [Report forms send notices, and the legal pages fill your own](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#report-forms-send-notices-and-the-legal-pages-fill-your-own)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `useMutation(api.admin.reportContent)` | `useReportForm(subject, { mode: 'quick' })` | reshaped | or `useReportForm(subject)` for a notice (DSA Art. 16) through `sendNotice`, with the fields it requires |

## [Browser error reports go through a tunnel on the app's own origin](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#browser-error-reports-go-through-a-tunnel-on-the-apps-own-origin)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@sentry/nuxt` | `@sentry/nuxt@^11.10.0` | reshaped | the peer range; an older SDK still reports, straight to the ingest, and the build and `doctor` warn |

## [The packaged UI reads its faces, lines and shadows from tokens](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#the-packaged-ui-reads-its-faces-lines-and-shadows-from-tokens)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[data-auth='form'], [data-pricing='table'], [data-admin]` | `[data-backend]` | reshaped | the outermost element of every packaged component and page; `<AppShell>` marks its own controls, not its root |

## [Passkeys check the person, and a ban says when it ends](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#passkeys-check-the-person-and-a-ban-says-when-it-ends)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `passkey(...)` | `authenticatorSelection: { userVerification: 'required' }` | reshaped | keep it in a passkey plugin of your own; the package's requires it, and refuses a passkey a security key with no PIN saved under 0.2 |
| `customResolveMethod: resolveSignInMethod` | — | removed | deprecated, still exported until a later minor release: Better Auth 1.7 names a code sign-in `email-otp` itself |
| `admin.bannedUserMessage` | `errors.forbidden_banned_until` | reshaped | the refusal carries `until`; word it with the `errors.forbidden_banned` and `errors.forbidden_banned_until` labels, since a message of your own drops `until` |

## [Better Auth 1.7, and a deploy for the backend's schema](https://nuxt-backend.dev/docs/ship/releases/upgrade#better-auth-17-and-a-deploy-for-the-backends-schema)

| Was | Now | Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `getIp` | `getIP` | reshaped | Better Auth's own rename in `better-auth/api`, not a name of this package |
| `authOptions` | `better-auth@>=1.7.16 <1.8.0` | reshaped | a Better Auth plugin added through it must support 1.7; deploy the backend for the new schema, then `nuxt-backend upgrade` |
